title: Quick Create Wizard - Create Coupon Code
text:
## Quick Create Wizard - Create Coupon Code
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105772
This will trigger a 4 step wizard to create coupon codes if the Easy Coupon Codes add-on is active
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180021321/original/BZ2x3Lu1obTR6NnvvNKttUEP2pceg4fHow.png?1780873264 | alt: ]

## Create coupon code
The admin will need to enter the basic information for the new promotional code. The discount type can be Percentage, fixed amount or price Override.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12167279799/original/GGxoJijQbULGaZYFWN0RdsGRuU27HzJe1A.png?1757536097 | alt: ]

## Usage Settings
The admin will be able to set timing, limits, and choose where this coupon can be used.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12167279832/original/SDq8CAjgim3Nq513SwxupHTdvzHIp7vkSg.png?1757536164 | alt: ]

## Specific Usage Types
When selecting the Specific Usage type additional options will show to set the coupon code
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12167279900/original/73lA45fgxIurmurA7jdeKmrI_2J-zG0eLA.png?1757536279 | alt: ]
When selecting Enabled - specific cases these options will show to complete the setup
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12167279977/original/cTrXEIwKQ4_zuMZxZrpAP6nC8m9AwzOmiw.png?1757536364 | alt: ]
For more information about the coupon add-on: Easy Coupon add-on

## Review and Create Coupon
Final step before creating the coupon, the admin will be able review the details before creating the coupon code.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12167280046/original/eU8JYcIdJ9MXEsGwxZ1XaXh_6Wye_Dl9Hg.png?1757536473 | alt: ]
Finally a success message will display once the coupon is created.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12167280093/original/ktmuS61FTPsQ5cudnLhGhHQPGK8OV44i0A.png?1757536511 | alt: ]
